parts:
Here's a message you can send directly to Aanchal:

:::writing{variant="chat_message" id="58341"}
Hey Aanchal,

After reviewing the tier structure, I think we need to simplify this significantly for where we are today and make sure the offers reflect what we can realistically deliver without overextending ourselves.

My biggest concern is that the three tiers currently feel like three completely different businesses instead of one core offer with varying levels of support.

### Tier 1 Needs to Change

Tier 1 should be a one-time investment only.

This is not a Done-With-You offer. It is a Do-It-Yourself offer.

The client receives:
- Their Luxora Market Blueprint
- Market analysis based on their location
- Positioning recommendations
- Ad spend guidance
- Playbooks
- KPI calculator

That's it.

We are not implementing anything with them, which means:
- No Slack
- No community (we don't have one yet)
- No onboarding calls
- No implementation support

Because we're simply providing a blueprint and tools, this will likely need its own payment funnel and a very simple onboarding process that only collects the information required to build the blueprint.

### Tier 2 Needs to Become Our 90-Day Done-With-You Program

This should be positioned as our guided implementation offer.

Changes:
- Remove Jacques' name entirely.
- Use "Tech Specialist" or simply refer to "our team."
- Make it a 90-day program.
- Monthly strategy calls instead of bi-weekly calls.
- Keep Slack access.
- Keep TLC AI access.
- Keep the Revenue Leak Audit.
- Keep the tech and ads diagnostic.

The goal is that we're guiding implementation while the client does the work.

After the 90 days, if they want to continue using:
- Slack
- TLC AI
- Ongoing support

there should be an ongoing partnership fee.

### Tier 3 Needs to Feel More Premium

I actually think Tier 3 should end up being more expensive, but I want to revisit pricing after I meet with the new ad creative team.

Changes:
- Remove Jacques' name.
- Never mention white-label anything.
- Simply state that campaigns are managed by our Meta specialists.
- Remove the wording about "10 clients or 100 clients." Most med spas have thousands of patients, so that language feels weak.

This should also be positioned as a 90-day implementation program.

Instead of promising topic calls or recurring coaching that doesn't exist yet, I would rather say something like:

- Direct access to Bethany during implementation
or
- Dedicated strategy access during implementation

We need to keep the promise simple and achievable.

After the 90 days:
- The ongoing partnership fee covers continued ad management.
- Continued Slack access.
- Continued TLC AI access.
- Continued strategic support.

### Future Vision

Long-term, I absolutely think team-led topic calls are a great addition.

I can see:
- Membership calls
- Front desk conversion calls
- Retention calls
- Ad strategy calls
- Wellness program calls

But I don't want us selling something we haven't built yet.

For now, let's focus on creating a simple, scalable offer that we know we can consistently deliver. Once we have more clients and more infrastructure, we can layer in group calls and additional support.

The biggest goal right now is simplicity and operational efficiency.
:::

I think this direction will also make the Luxora ladder much clearer:

**Tier 1:** Blueprint (DIY)  
**Tier 2:** Guided Implementation (DWY - 90 Days)  
**Tier 3:** Full Implementation (DFY - 90 Days)

Same outcome. Same methodology. Different level of support. That's a much cleaner story for prospects to understand and for the team to deliver.

These tiers still feel very separate and not as if we are doing one offer. But I will try to express my thoughts on these as clear as possible. Tier one needs to be a one-time investment. That is, you do it. We are not doing it with them. And from the looks of it we will need an entirely different onboarding process and that's going to be hard. It'll have to be a totally different payment funnel. With a totally different onboarding process because we are simply providing them with a blueprint based off of their location so we don't really need to know anything about their business. And remove them from a community, we don't have that yet. 

Tier 2 needs to be a done with you and a 90-day program. Please take Jacques name out and use his title or just say tech specialist. I think they should do monthly calls instead of bi-weekly calls because they still have access to our channel and our AI. 

Tier 3 needs to be more expensive I think... I'll get a better idea when I meet the new team of agency ad creative. Again, take shock's name out of it. And never mention that we are using a white label company. Just let them know we will fully run their campaigns managed by our meta specialist s. Remove the verbage at the end. AI powered automation where it says built a scale quickly so works whether you have 10 clients or 100. Most men's boss have thousands of clients revolving. 
Eventually we will have topic calls. Unfortunately, we don't have that now and that will be replacing bi-weekly calls with me. So I would say direct access with Bethany to jump on a call if you need it type thing. Or say a dedicated line to speak to? Bethany during implementation process. Also indicate that it's a 90-day program. 

We want to keep it as simple as possible in the beginning so that we're not overextending ourselves. 

The done with you and done for you need to be understood that after the 90 days there will be a partnership fee to continue using our slack channel for the done with you hybrid and TLC AI and obviously for the third tier it will be us continuing running ads and having access to me. 

We can add the calls in once they'll start to happen and we get more clients.

These are the tiers I'm referring too: Choose Your Path

Three Ways to Work
With The Luxora Collective
Same proven playbook. The only difference is how much of the heavy lifting our team does for you — and how deeply we integrate into your business.

Tier 1

$5,000
One-time investment · Done With You
Strategy + Guidance
We build your blueprint. You execute with our guidance. You get the full strategic picture, the ad spend clarity, and every playbook we have — so you can run with confidence.

Strategy & Market Analysis
Luxora Market Blueprint — a custom market analysis covering your local competitive landscape, ideal patient profile, and the exact positioning that will make your med spa the obvious choice in your area
Ad spend assessment — we analyze your current or planned ad budget and tell you exactly how much you should be spending, on which platforms, and why — so nothing is wasted
Step-by-step ad guidance — after the assessment, we walk you through exactly how to run your own ads: what to say, what to target, what to measure, and when to adjust. You leave knowing how to do this yourself with confidence
Playbooks & Operational Tools
Full access to all TLC playbooks — our complete step-by-step operational library covering front desk conversion, client retention, membership structures, upsell frameworks, team training, and lifetime value optimization. These are the exact systems Bethany used across 3 med spa locations — now handed directly to you
KPI calculator — a custom-built tool that shows you the exact numbers your business should be hitting across bookings, conversion rates, client spend, and retention — so you always know if you're on track or falling behind
Support
Access to the TLC community — post questions, share wins, get feedback, and learn alongside other med spa owners working through the same playbooks
Get Started with Tier 1
Best for
Self-starters who want the full strategy and operational toolkit to build and run their own growth system
★ Most Popular
Tier 2

$10,000
Investment · 1:1 Hybrid
Diagnostic + Guided Implementation
We diagnose everything and show you exactly how to fix it. You get a professional-grade audit of your ads and tech, a clear roadmap to act on, and the ongoing support to make sure you do.

Everything in Tier 1, plus:
Tech and Ads Diagnostic Report — our tech specialist Jacques conducts a comprehensive audit of your current ad setup, tech stack, and digital infrastructure. You receive a detailed written report, a prioritised action list of exactly what to fix and in what order, plus a personal Loom walkthrough from Jacques talking you through every finding so nothing gets lost in translation
Revenue Leak Audit — we identify exactly where your business is quietly losing money across bookings, client spend, follow-up gaps, and team performance, and show you step by step how to fix each one yourself
Support & Access
Dedicated Slack channel with direct access to the TLC team — message us any time with questions and get real answers from the people who built your system
Access to TLC AI — our proprietary AI assistant trained on the full TLC playbook library, available any time you need a strategic answer, a script, or a second opinion
Bi-weekly strategy calls with a TLC team member — structured check-ins to review your progress on the audit findings, work through any roadblocks, and keep implementation moving
KPI calculator — clear benchmarks for conversion, retention, average spend, and revenue targets so you always know exactly where your business stands and what to push toward next
Get Started with Tier 2
Best for
Founders who want a professional diagnosis of exactly what to fix — and the guidance to implement it themselves with confidence
Tier 3

$15,000
Investment · Done For You
Complete Implementation
We handle everything — strategy, tech, ads, and implementation. You show up for your clients. Our team installs the entire Luxora playbook into your business and runs it alongside you.

Everything in Tier 2, plus:
Full tech onboarding by Jacques — our tech specialist builds and configures your complete digital infrastructure, from CRM setup and automation flows to funnel build and systems integration. Everything is set up correctly from day one so you never have to troubleshoot it
White label Meta ad team — your campaigns are fully managed by our dedicated Meta specialists end-to-end, covering creative, targeting, optimization, and reporting. You never need to touch the ad account
AI-powered CRM automation — we build and implement a fully automated CRM system using AI to handle lead follow-up, booking reminders, reactivation sequences, and client retention flows. Built to scale quickly so it works whether you have 10 clients or 100
Revenue Leak implementation — we don't just identify your revenue gaps, we fix them. Every finding from the audit gets resolved by our team directly inside your business
Full playbook implementation — every process, script, membership framework, retention system, and team protocol from the TLC playbook gets built into your business, not handed to you to figure out
Elite Access
Bi-weekly calls with Bethany — available as an option for clients who want direct access to our lead expert to review performance, remove blockers, and stay aligned on strategy
Access to TLC team topic calls — join live sessions led by our specialists covering retention, ads, front desk conversion, memberships, and more. Each call is led by a dedicated expert on that topic so you always get depth, not generalities
KPI calculator — tailored benchmarks built around your specific business with full visibility into performance at every stage so you can measure real progress in real time
Get Started with Tier 3
Best for
Founders who want it fully off their plate and want the best possible outcome, fast
Not sure which tier is right for you? Book a free Growth Assessment call — we'll help you figure out the best fit based on where you are right now.

Send a message to Aanchal explaining my thoughts on these tiers. And the pivots that we need to make at first until we can implement some of the bigger things. But in the long run I think team calls will be great
